scope: Real-browser mounts and DOM event interactions; 91 catalog entries, 83 gallery examples and focused behavioral checks. Does not imply complete browser compatibility, visual approval or production integration.

checks.name: All 109 catalog entries hydrate without exceptions and have unique instance IDs
All 83 documented variant configurations hydrate without exceptions
Single date: draft, cancel, confirmed event and hidden form value
Calendar arrows navigate by day, Escape dismisses and returns focus
Date range requires two endpoints and preserves order and draft cancellation
Disabled days cannot be picked; invalid input leaves last committed value
Range across a forbidden date is rejected at confirmation
Time columns commit hours/minutes/seconds and support clear
Time range rejects inverted values, keeps legal manual minutes
Date-time range independently commits start/end dates and clock values
Month/year/quarter panels return the correct period format
Month range manual end edit accepts friendly formatted start display
ISO week around New Year keeps its ISO year, not calendar year
Multi-date has in-field tags, overflow management and cancel protection
Disabled and readonly temporal fields cannot open or clear
Unmount removes temporal popups and their document listeners
Checkbox all/partial state preserves disabled checked items
Radio options are configurable and switch submits booleans
Password show/hide and clear preserve the input and events
Textarea count follows edited content
Dual slider prevents endpoints crossing and returns a numeric pair
Autocomplete keyboard selection closes suggestions and emits ID
Transfer requires explicit movement and protects disabled options
Tree expands, searches and maintains parent mixed/all checks
Tabs skip disabled items on keyboard navigation and show their own panel
Steps notify an index and move the current marker
Menu disabled actions do not fire; selected action returns its ID
Dialog confirms through an action; cancel leaves value unchanged
Upload validates format/count/size, deduplicates and removes local files
Charts retain actual configured values in accessible details, including empty data
All documented examples fit a 320px host without page-level overflow
All 109 catalog defaults fit a 320px host without page-level overflow
Temporal popup stays within its native modal top layer
Tree keyboard arrows traverse, expand and return to parent
Disabled temporal values are excluded from native form submission
Range presets respect restrictions and require explicit confirmation
